current.changeLog:
Works on the NA and ASIA clients too.
Keeps working after a small game patch that leaves the game's version as it is.
The mod's file has a new name: delete the older app.gunmarks.reticle_0.1.0.wotmod.

previous.changeLog:
The mod is one file now, with its own version and its own updates. It no longer needs Gunmarks Core: once every Gunmarks mod you have is updated, delete app.gunmarks.core_0.1.1.wotmod.
The settings page has a tab for each Gunmarks mod, under its name, and lists each with its own version.
The notice of a new version lists each of your mods that has one, with the version you have and the new one.
The garage panel no longer stays on top of the equipment, shells and consumables screens.

Version 1.0.1 (WoT 2.4.0.2)
    - Compatibility: Updated for World of Tanks 2.4.0.2.
    - Core: Upgraded underlying Dispersion Reticle library to v3.1.12.
    - In-Game Settings: Added dedicated Jimbo settings menu in ModsSettingsAPI and direct launcher in ModsListAPI (hangar popup) with bilingual support (EN/PL).
    - Live Tuning: Switch between v1 Classic, v2 Full HUD, and v3 Bold directly in-game without editing JSON files.
    - Presets: Ensured v2 Full HUD is the canonical default across all settings.
    - Fix: Restored sniper lens frame in v3 Bold variant (now features full sniper HUD with bold reticle lines).
    - Fix: Handled C-style line comments in config files to prevent JSON loading issues.
    - Documentation: Updated install paths for 2.4.0.2.
